message:
Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/glog && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json')
trace=[
  {"step":1,"file":"src/fuzz_demangle.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":19,"var":"Data/Size","code":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput(const unsigned char *Data, unsigned Size)","note":"Attacker-controlled bytes enter the fuzz target as the raw input buffer and length."},
  {"step":2,"file":"src/fuzz_demangle.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":20,"var":"Size","code":"if (Size >= 4095) return 0;","note":"Inputs shorter than 4095 bytes continue into the vulnerable path, so the fuzzer can supply a crafted mangled symbol."},
  {"step":3,"file":"src/fuzz_demangle.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":23,"var":"Buffer","code":"char Buffer[Size + 1]; std::memcpy(Buffer, Data, Size); Buffer[Size] = 0;","note":"The raw bytes are copied into a stack buffer and NUL-terminated, producing the C string consumed by the demangler."},
  {"step":4,"file":"src/fuzz_demangle.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":25,"var":"demangled/Size","code":"google::Demangle(Buffer, demangled, Size);","note":"The crafted string is passed to the demangler with an output size equal to the attacker-controlled input length."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src/demangle.cc","function":"Demangle","line":1357,"var":"state","code":"InitState(&state, mangled, out, out_size);","note":"Demangle initializes parsing state over the attacker string and the caller-provided output buffer."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src/demangle.cc","function":"ParseTopLevelMangledName","line":1305,"var":"state.mangled_cur","code":"if (ParseMangledName(state)) { ... if (state->mangled_cur[0] != '\\0') { ... if (state->mangled_cur[0] == '@') { MaybeAppend(state, state->mangled_cur); return true; } return false; }","note":"After a successful parse, any trailing '@' suffix is appended verbatim to the output, so the remaining attacker-controlled tail is copied without additional validation."},
  {"step":7,"file":"src/demangle.cc","function":"MaybeAppendWithLength","line":258,"var":"state->out_cur","code":"Append(state, str, length);","note":"Appending the attacker-controlled suffix advances the output cursor while checking only the remaining output space."},
  {"step":8,"file":"src/demangle.cc","function":"Append","line":214,"var":"state->out_cur/state->out_end","code":"if (state->out_cur + 1 < state->out_end) { *state->out_cur = str[i]; ... } else { state->overflowed = true; break; }","note":"The sink is the stack write into the fixed output buffer; if the crafted suffix and parse path drive the output past the buffer boundary, ASan reports a stack overflow."}
]
p.write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace, indent=2))
print(p.read_text())
PY
bash ./submit.sh /workspace/poc1 /workspace/candidate_trace.json > /tmp/submit1.log 2>&1; ec=$?; echo EXIT:$ec; cat /tmp/submit1.log | tail -80
